assumptions: union strategy = Filter (option 1), decided by human at fleet CONFIRM

"Invalid" means "not accepted by member 0": the filter only drops a case member 0 itself rejects, so a case member 0 accepts (a legitimate valid-input or boundary case) is never removed even if a sibling also accepts it.

Acceptance is a local scalar predicate mirroring the constraints the case generators already honour (enum, min/maxLength, integer, min/max, dateOnly) rather than a JSON-Schema validator dependency; the canary shape model is narrower than JSON Schema.
A date member accepts a value when it matches the ISO form dateCases emits: YYYY-MM-DD when dateOnly, otherwise a full ISO-8601 timestamp. No other date constraint exists in the shape model today.
A union nested inside a union (expressible in the type, not producible by isResolvedUnion) accepts a value when any of its members does; defensive only.
accepts() is module-private in strategies.ts rather than a new module, to avoid adding an entropy entry point for ~45 lines.
Tests were added to the existing ts/test/gen-data-generate.test.ts; a new test file was deliberately avoided because it would trip the entropy ratchet.
The pre-existing test 'a union defaults and plans cases from its first member' encoded the #1039 bug as an expectation and was amended (not deleted) to state the filtered contract.
Regenerated gen-data fixtures for union fields will now carry fewer negative cases; nothing in this repo asserts a fixture case count, but downstream committed fixtures would shift on regeneration.
